reason: Backend spec overview — checker references it to scope what guidelines apply to this task (all backend, no frontend).

Verifies folder layout, env var coverage in .env.example, and forbidden-pattern compliance (no express imports in services/, no fs imports outside storage/, no process.env reads outside config/env.ts).

Verifies AppError shape, error response JSON shape, provider failure → AppError mapping table coverage in tests, and the forbidden patterns (empty catches, sentinel-value returns, leaking upstream bodies).
Verifies pino singleton + redact paths, no console.* anywhere, requestId presence on every log emitted during a request, and that error logs use {err} field instead of string interpolation.

Verifies tsconfig strict flags, ESLint baseline rules in place, required npm scripts present, pre-commit gate active, and code-review checklist items (no any, no as-bypass, errors via AppError, tests cover happy + at least one failure path).
Verifies no DB driver / ORM in package.json, fs.promises only (no sync fs), path-traversal guard present in storage/localStorage.ts, and UUID-based filenames.

Authoritative acceptance criteria + scope. Checker confirms each of the 11 ACs is satisfied and that nothing in 'Out of Scope' was inadvertently implemented (no image endpoints, no real 2API calls, no Docker/CI, no DB).
